sections.content: Acceptance plan for trust recovery against baseline 3c285bcc and commit 868328c8. It preserves current lifecycle ownership, requires self-hosted execution, and excludes Knowledge publication, auto Bootstrap, runtime or release archive steps, and multi-maintainer signing. Core rules bind requests to contract, authority manifest, Knowledge selection, successor kinds, and Skill-input contract, with strict handling for freshness drift, successor reservation, legacy prior-RED checks, and completion handoff evidence.
sections.title: Requirements

sections.content: migration_bridge.py materializes declared Quick Dev RED tests for slices R0, R1, and R2 only, writes known test paths under repository root, and aborts on undeclared slices or conflicting existing targets. test_completion_handoff_integrity.py checks candidate source identity stability and excludes generated evidence paths. These sources describe constrained test generation and integrity checks for the completion handoff flow.
sections.title: Migration And Test Coverage

sections.content: terminal_full.py is the validator and receipt publisher. It binds hashes for contract, registry, candidate source manifest, and receipts; enforces declared slice maps and repo-bounded sources; requires authorization state alignment and valid receipts; and publishes a canonical completion receipt on full pass. validate_all.py supplies slice identity helpers and snapshot hashing for candidate sources, registry, terminal state, and closure definitions.
sections.title: Terminal Validation
